IdeoPresetCategoryDef.label: Jujutsu paths
IdeoPresetCategoryDef.description: Colony philosophies inspired by Jujutsu Kaisen. Choose one path, then customize compatible memes, roles and rituals. Innate techniques remain rare and random.

PreceptDef.label: no obligation
PreceptDef.description: Helping strangers is a personal choice. This precept adds no mood reward or penalty for charity.

MemeDef.label: Guardians of Humanity
MemeDef.description:
Sorcerers shoulder the danger so ordinary people can live. Inspired by Nanami, Yuji and the protective ideal of jujutsu, this path values rescue, exorcism and service rather than inherited privilege.
Protection is a duty. Completing a school contract grants +4 mood for 3 days; personally exorcising a hostile curse grants +3 for 2 days. Living with another non-sorcerer colonist grants +2 mood. Charity matters and harming innocent prisoners is condemned.

story(uses=1,tag=meme_JJK_Meme_Guardian)->Followers took dangerous exorcism work so others could live in peace.

MemeDef.label: The New Generation
MemeDef.description:
Build a future that does not sacrifice the young to the old order. Inspired by Gojo as a teacher, this path prizes mentorship, humane treatment and learning over clan pedigree. Belief does not create innate techniques.
Completing an actual mentored jujutsu practice session grants both participating believers +4 mood for 3 days. Training without a mentor grants no memory. Ordinary colonists and heavenly-restricted fighters face no additional JJK prejudice.

MemeDef.label: Clan Orthodoxy
MemeDef.description:
Order, pedigree and rank preserve jujutsu society. Inspired by conservative clans and higher-ups, this path honors innate talent and qualified leadership. Its hierarchy can stabilize a school or alienate those it undervalues.
A living Grade 1 or higher sorcerer in the ideology leader role grants +3 mood; a lower-ranked or non-sorcerer leader causes -3. No leader adds no extra JJK penalty. Innate technique users receive +8 opinion, others -4. Completing a school contract grants +3 mood for 3 days. Leadership remains assignable regardless of grade.

MemeDef.label: Sorcerer Supremacy
MemeDef.description:
A world for sorcerers alone. Inspired by Geto after his defection, this exclusionary creed blames non-sorcerers for the world of curses. It is distinct from the protective ideal he held as a student.
With at least two free colonists present, any non-sorcerer colonist causes -5 mood; an entirely sorcerer community grants +3. Known sorcerers receive +10 opinion and non-sorcerers -15, including zero-energy heavenly-restricted people. Hostile curse exorcism grants +3 mood for 2 days. Temporary borrowed energy does not confer membership. No execution or conversion is automatic.

MemeDef.label: The Sovereign Self
MemeDef.description:
Live according to your own appetite and acknowledge strength wherever it appears. Inspired by Sukuna, this creed rejects obligations of protection and clan pedigree. It respects formidable opponents rather than granting power through worship.
Personally killing a standing hostile with combat power at least 100 and at least your pawnkind combat power grants +5 mood for 3 days. Downed victims and prisoners do not qualify. Grade 1+ sorcerers, zero-energy heavenly-restricted fighters, or people with Melee 12+ receive +10 opinion. Human meat is accepted, not required.

MemeDef.label: Cursed Evolution
MemeDef.description:
Push cursed energy beyond its present limits. Inspired by Kenjaku, this experimental philosophy values discovery and treats conventional moral limits as obstacles. Unlike Geto, it seeks new possibilities for cursed energy rather than a world without curses.
Finishing a Jujutsu research project grants believers on player home maps +5 mood for 4 days. The required fast-research precept increases research speed by 25%. Organ use is accepted and charity is not required. Belief grants no technique, reserve gene or guaranteed awakening.
